name: MH3G #1/#2/#3 player-speed-state candidate
purpose_zh: 验证 0x028924AC 在玩家每帧更新中从 r7+0x608 读取动作/时间倍率，并记录 r7+0x440 累加器；只采样，不写寄存器或内存，也不把它误报为全局帧率。
purpose_en: Prove that 0x028924AC loads an action/time multiplier from r7+0x608 during the per-frame player update and record the r7+0x440 accumulator. Sample only; do not modify registers or memory or misreport this as global frame rate.
operator_steps_zh: 进入可自由操控猎人的任务，关闭所有动态金手指，先以站立或普通移动触发一次基线断点。
另取独立 trace，在行走、游泳或执行动作时触发，并对照 r7+0x608 的浮点值和 r7+0x440 累加器是否随帧更新。
该 trace 只能证明倍率消费路径；必须再完成归一化输入 spec 对 L/R 的 trace，且找到安全跨钩子桥接后才能创建 pack。
operator_steps_en: Enter a quest where the hunter is freely controllable, disable all dynamic cheats, and take one baseline hit while standing or moving normally.
Take an independent trace while walking, swimming, or performing an action, then compare the float at r7+0x608 and the r7+0x440 accumulator across frames.
This trace proves only the multiplier consumer. The normalized-input spec must separately prove L/R, and no pack may be created until a safe cross-hook bridge is found.
